options.name: Rays per Frequency Band
options.description: Number of rays used for every frequency band in every source-reciever simulation.

options.name: Histogram sampling rate
options.description: Sampling rate of the simulated histogram.

options.name: Propagation medium
options.description: Specifies atmospheric conditions used for Speed and Attenuation: temp, rel hum, atmo pres, sat vap pres, CO2. Use x for missing values.

options.name: Speed of Sound
options.description: Speed of sound in m/s that is used in simulation.

options.name: Maximum Energy Loss
options.description: A path is terminated once it has lost this much energy. 100 dB (as in Richter's comparison with RAVEN) leaves enough margin for T30; lower values cut the late reverberation and bias T30 short.

options.name: Speed of Sound Method
options.description: 1 = Simple: ISO 9613-1, temperature only. 2 = Ideal Gas: temperature, humidity and pressure. 3 = Cramer: temperature, humidity, pressure and CO2. 4 = Own Value: the value given in Speed of Sound. Missing medium values are taken from misuka's standard medium (25 C, 60 % RH, 101325 Pa, 3167 Pa, 400 ppm).

options.name: Apply Air Attenuation
options.description: If set to 'Apply', attenuation will be calculated with bin correct distances from temp, rel hum, atmo pres. Fails run if input is not provided.

options.name: Scattering
options.description: Used for controlling scattering on all surface materials for the different frequency bands [s(125), s(250), s(500), s(1000), s(2000)].
